title: An integrated transcriptomics and network pharmacology approach to explore the mechanism of Wang-Bi tablet against SAPHO syndrome.
authors: Wang, Ting; Gong, Xun; Xia, Congmin; Kong, Weijia; Geng, Shaohui; Jiang, Haixu; Xiao, Enfan; Wang, Hesong; Yu, Yingcai; Li, Chen; Yuan, Kai
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组学和网络药理学探讨中药WBT治疗SAPHO综合征的机制，仅涉及分子对接验证药物-靶点亲和力，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: SAPHO syndrome is recognized as a rare entity with damage to skin and bones due to inflammation. Currently, the treatment for SAPHO syndrome is still a challenge in clinical practice. In this study, an integrated transcriptomics and network pharmacology approach was applied to explore the therapeutic effect and mechanism of Wang-Bi tablet (WBT) on SAPHO syndrome. METHODS: The main components of WBT and their targets, as well as the targets of SAPHO syndrome, were collected from databases. Network visualization was performed using Cytoscape software. The GO and KEGG enrichment analysis was executed by David dataset. Then, the molecular mechanism of WBT improving SAPHO syndrome was validated by transcriptomics of peripheral blood neutrophils in SAPHO syndrome. Finally, the above results were validated by molecular docking. RESULTS: The Network Pharmacology results showed there are 152 core targets for WBT treatment on SAPHO syndrome. RNA-seq data showed 442 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in peripheral blood neutrophils of SAPHO patients. Intriguingly, NIK/NF-kappaB-, MyD88-dependent toll-like receptor-, and MAPK pathway were included in the enrichment results of network pharmacology and RNA-seq. Moreover, we verified that the core components of WBT have good affinity with the core targets of NIK/NF-kappaB-, MyD88-dependent toll-like receptor-, and MAPK pathway by molecular docking. CONCLUSIONS: This study illustrated that the possible mechanisms of WBT against SAPHO syndrome may be related to NIK/NF-kappaB-, MyD88-dependent toll-like receptor-, and MAPK pathway, and further experiments are needed to prove these predictions.
abstract_zh: 背景：SAPHO综合征被认为是一种罕见的因炎症导致皮肤和骨骼损伤的疾病。目前，SAPHO综合征的治疗在临床实践中仍是一个挑战。本研究采用整合转录组学和网络药理学方法，探讨王痹片（WBT）对SAPHO综合征的治疗效果及其机制。方法：从数据库中收集WBT的主要成分及其靶点，以及SAPHO综合征的靶点。使用Cytoscape软件进行网络可视化。通过David数据集进行GO和KEGG富集分析。然后，通过SAPHO综合征外周血中性粒细胞的转录组学验证WBT改善SAPHO综合征的分子机制。最后，通过分子对接验证上述结果。结果：网络药理学结果显示，WBT治疗SAPHO综合征有152个核心靶点。RNA-seq数据显示，SAPHO患者外周血中性粒细胞中有442个差异表达基因（DEGs）。有趣的是，NIK/NF-kappaB、MyD88依赖性toll样受体和MAPK通路包含在网络药理学和RNA-seq的富集结果中。此外，我们通过分子对接验证了WBT的核心成分与NIK/NF-kappaB、MyD88依赖性toll样受体和MAPK通路的核心靶点具有良好的亲和力。结论：本研究阐明WBT对抗SAPHO综合征的可能机制可能与NIK/NF-kappaB、MyD88依赖性toll样受体和MAPK通路有关，需要进一步实验来证明这些预测。
